    ∃ e f : V, ∃ a b c : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < c ∧
      G e e = 1 ∧ G f f = 1 ∧ G e f = 0 ∧
      v = a • e ∧ w = b • e + c • f :=

  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
